entry_item.definition: [--xu or –ky, = nincid-] v.i To snap the fingers.
T. se gol gtogs pa; S. acchata . Snap of the fingers; a very small division of time; also a ceremonial gesture; the sound by which a meditator is aroused from profound meditation.
claquer les mains, faire claquer ses doigts. 2 instant, moment, clin-d'oeil.

example.unicode: ᠦᠴᠦᠭᠦᠺᠡᠨ ᠢᠨᠴᠢᠳᠬᠤ ᠎ᠶᠢᠨ ᠳᠡᠳᠣᠶᠢᠺᠡᠨ ᠪᠡᠷ ᠦᠯᠦ ᠬᠠᠭᠠᠴᠠᠬᠤ ᠪᠣᠯᠪᠠᠢ
example.definition: encore un moment et il ne se séparrait plus
